title: fix(plugin-detail): a multi-file field takes the full row of the record detail grid
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDkfvfHz1xuFHJCzCLY41kt)_

domain:ui#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwbC5V63Ykvc7r6swv

Fixes #32746

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:记录详情页的自动布局里,`file` / `image` 字段若在对象上声明了 `multiple: true`(多文件),现在占满整行;单文件字段、原有的长文本类字段(textarea / markdown / html / richtext)宽度不变。
- **为什么改**:报销单的多张电子发票放在一个多文件字段里,原来只占半行,文件名被截断成「…」,审批人分不清是哪张发票;详情页没有作者能设的宽度键,只能由默认布局来解决。
- **风险与回滚**:只影响详情页里多文件字段的列宽,不改协议、不加可编写键、表单不变;回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看**:① `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/autoLayout.ts` 新增的 `isWideDetailField`;② `DetailSection.tsx` 里把 `objectSchema?.fields` 传给 `applyDetailAutoLayout` 的那一处。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.multiFileSpan-32746.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全绿(多文件与多图占两列;单文件、普通字段一格;textarea 仍占整行)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/autoLayout.ts`: a new `isWideDetailField(field, objectFields)` answers whether a detail field takes the full row: a wide type, as before (`isWideFieldType`), or a `file` / `image` field (bare spec name or its `field:` widget id) whose OBJECT field declares `multiple: true`. `applyAutoSpan` and `applyDetailAutoLayout` take the object's field map as an optional last argument and use it. `isWideFieldType` and `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES` are unchanged.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`: hands `objectSchema?.fields` to `applyDetailAutoLayout`.
- `record-details.boundaryColumns-9056.test.tsx`: its pass-through wrapper of `applyDetailAutoLayout` now forwards every argument, so its "same signature" note stays true.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

## Why

An expense claim carries its e-invoices in one `file` field with `multiple: true`. In a half-width cell of the detail grid each file name was cut short, so the approver could not tell the invoices apart. The form lets the author widen the field with `span: 'full'`; the detail panel has no width key the author can set, so the auto layout is the only lever.

## Route chosen, and why

- **Detail only, not the form.** The form's `span: 'auto'` rule is stated in `@objectstack/spec` (the `span` describe in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` names exactly the types that resolve to the full column count), so widening the form would make that shipped describe false and needs a `packages/spec` change, which this card fences out. The form already has the author's escape (`span: 'full'`); the detail has none.
- **A field-level rule beside the type set, not a new member of `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`.** A single file is one short name and reads fine in one cell, so the type alone does not make the field wide. Keeping `isWideFieldType` type-only also keeps the cross-surface pin `richtextSurfaceParity.test.tsx` ("the detail and form auto-layouts agree on EVERY spec field type") true without touching it.
- **`multiple` is read from the object field, not from the detail entry.** It is the field's declaration; `DetailViewField` declares no such key, and the rich descriptors the app hands the section (name, label, type, options, reference) do not carry it. Reading the object schema the section already holds needs no new key on any face.
- **Spec history (#18516).** That card corrected the spec describe that wrongly named `file` as a wide FORM widget; it said nothing about the detail panel, and this change does not touch the form or that describe.

## Tests

- `DetailSection.multiFileSpan-32746.test.tsx` (new, renders `DetailSection` in a 2-column section): a `multiple: true` `file` field and a `multiple: true` `image` field carry `md:col-span-2`; CONTROL: a single `file` field and a `text` field do not; CONTROL: a `textarea` still does.
- `autoLayout.wideSpelling.test.ts`, new top-level `describe`: `applyAutoSpan` spans exactly the multi-value file/image fields and the textarea among six fields; both spellings (spec name and `mapFieldTypeToFormType` widget id) answer; with no object-field map, or without `multiple`, spans are unchanged; an authored `span` still wins; `isWideFieldType('file')` / `('image')` stay `false`.

<details><summary>Ablation (two legs, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, mutation proven on disk, restored to HEAD)</summary>

1. `autoLayout.ts`: `MULTI_FILE_FIELD_TYPES.has(field.type) &&` → `false &&` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `e5c6a368e56c` → `e84f53bba7b5`). Result: 4 failed / 11 passed — the four multi-file assertions red (two in each file), every control green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. `DetailSection.tsx`: the `objectSchema?.fields` argument → `undefined` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `136fbeef5c24` → `f5bff3d4b9ed`). Result: 2 failed / 2 passed — the multi-file and multi-image render legs red, both controls green. Restored: blob == HEAD.

The tests import `../autoLayout` and `../DetailSection` by relative path (source, no dist), so no rebuild sits between mutation and run.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Not changed: a section whose fields reach the layout as bare names.** `applyAutoSpan` reads `field.type` off the detail entry. A page that persists `record:details` sections as bare field names (the spec's only `fields` spelling) hands the layout `{ name, label }` with no type, so no wide field — textarea included — is widened there; the type is filled later by `enrichDetailField`, after layout. The new rule reads the same `field.type`, so it behaves exactly like the existing wide types on every path (the running app's default record page and `{ group }` references carry the type and are covered). Not measured in a browser; noted, not filed.
- **A field-level layout hint** (an author-set width for the detail panel) would be `domain:spec` work and is not proposed here; the default above covers the card's case without it.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s barrel is unchanged: `isWideDetailField` and `DetailLayoutObjectFields` are exported from `autoLayout.ts` only, for its tests.

Final head `5fb7797c`, `origin/main` merged once (`5c0f1134`).
